meta.title: How we work
meta.description: Six steps, from diagnosis to scale. A method you can read, with identified deliverables at every step.

method.intro: An agency that cannot explain its method is mostly charging for opacity. Here is ours, in order, with what you receive at each step.

discover.detail: We start from what already exists: your business, your customers, what you have tried and what did not work. This step avoids rebuilding what was already standing.

strategize.detail: This is where direction is set: who we speak to, what we say, on which channels, and how we will measure that it works. Without this step, everything else becomes a matter of taste.

create.detail: Identity, content, video, pages: production follows the direction that was set, never the other way round. Each format is built for the place it will actually be seen.

distribute.detail: Publishing is not enough. Distribution is organised — rhythm, targeting, media budget — so the content reaches the right people rather than the most people.

optimize.detail: The numbers decide. We keep what performs, cut what does not, and explain why — including when the answer is inconvenient.

scale.detail: Once something works repeatably, we increase volume without breaking what was working. It is the one step that assumes the previous ones held.

method.ctaTitle: Want to see what this looks like in your case?
method.ctaBody: The first step is a conversation, not a contract.

meta.title: About
meta.description: Adrar Media, a communication and digital marketing agency in Morocco. What we do, how we work, and what we turn down.

about.intro: Adrar Media works with Moroccan brands and businesses that want to exist online seriously — not merely to be present there.

facts.label: Model
facts.value: Strategy, creation and distribution under one roof

about.missionBody: To make our clients' real business legible, desirable and measurable online. In practice: bringing strategy, creation and distribution under one roof so that a single intent does not dilute as it passes from one supplier to the next — and reporting on what it produces, with figures and their sources.
missionPoints: One intent, from positioning through to conversion.
A written scope agreed before the work starts, not after.
Results reported with their origin, including the disappointing ones.
about.visionBody: Brands from here that hold their own against brands from anywhere. We do not believe in a more forgiving Moroccan standard: the bar is the same everywhere. “From local to global” is not a closing line, it is the order in which we work — roots first, reach second.
visionPoints: Local is not a ceiling, it is a starting point.
Work that holds over time rather than a trend caught in time.
Scale comes only after something already works.
about.nameBody: “Adrar” means mountain in Amazigh. The name says where we come from and what we try to build: something that lasts, visible from a distance, and not dependent on the trend of the moment.
storyBody: We bring strategy, creation and distribution under one roof. That is not a sales argument: it is what allows a single intention to hold from positioning all the way to conversion, instead of thinning out as it passes from one supplier to the next.
We work with organisations that have real activity and real customers. Our job is to make it legible, desirable and measurable online.

values.title: Sourced numbers
values.body: Every metric we publish carries its origin. A number without a source is a sales argument, not a result.

values.title: A written scope
values.body: What is included is written down, and so is what is not. Bad surprises always hide in what was left unsaid.

values.title: Saying no
values.body: When a request falls outside our scope or will not serve your business, we say so. Less pleasant at the time, more useful afterwards.

values.title: Work before talk
values.body: Our projects are published with the agreement of the clients concerned. Where agreement is missing, the project does not appear.

about.teamIntro: A three-person team under one roof: Yassine leads the agency, Nabil manages communities and Zineb shapes its visual work.
